text:
elaine: CI red on master for runtime unit tests — flaky failure in `test_timer_callback_random_failure`.

matt: re-rerunning now (CI job 8791).

ci-bot: job 8792 queued by matt.

matt: second run passed locally, failing ~1/8 runs. failure snippet:
```
AssertionError: expected 3 callbacks, got 2
File tests/unit/test_timer.py,line 42, in test_timer_callback_random_failure
    assert call_count == 3
```

sana: @matt can you share the repro command? I'll try stress runs.

matt: `pytest tests/unit/test_timer.py::test_timer_callback_random_failure --maxfail=1 -q --count=50` (pytest-repeat plugin)

elaine: this started after PR #3421 (timer coalescing). @alex any thoughts?

alex: probably related — coalescing can change ordering when multiple short timers land same tick. I can try a quick change to make wheel deterministic in tests.

isaac: bisect might help. @matt can you run `git bisect` with a tiny script that repeats the test so it fails deterministically?

matt: starting bisect now, will run ~200 repeats per commit. ping me if you want to help.

sana: FYI adding a fake clock to the test (advance by microseconds) helped once in my local run during debugging.

alex: created draft branch `alex/deterministic-wheels` to add a test-only flag `SCHED_DETERMINISTIC=1` — will open PR in a bit.

elaine: for the CI side, maybe add a flaky annotation and avoid blocking merges until we get a fix? cc @eng-sre

matt: agree — adding `@flaky` with 3 reruns for now. I'll add a short note in the PR description.

ci-bot: rerun completed: job 8792 passed.

elaine: thanks — keep updates here with bisect results.

matt: update: bisect points to commit 9f3a2c8 (timer coalescing). I'll post full bisect log once done.

sana: I can take the follow-up to add mock clock if you want @alex.

alex: thanks, please do. I'll make the wheel have a deterministic ordering under env var.

matt: done for now — opening follow-up issue #178 for deterministic scheduler in tests.

elaine: nice. closing triage for now, reopen if it resurfaces. :thumbsup:
